item.title: Edit Workspace Quota
item.description: This section describes how to edit workspace quota. In the KubeSphere platform, multiple clusters can be authorized to the same workspace. You can set resource quotas for each cluster in the workspace settings. Prerequisites You need to join a workspace and have the Workspace Settings Management permission in the workspace. For more information, see Workspace Members and Workspace Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Workspace Settings Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: View Workspace Quotas
item.description: This section describes how to view workspace quotas. Prerequisites You need to join a workspace and have the Workspace Settings View permission in the workspace. For more information, see Workspace Members and Workspace Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Workspace Settings View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Workspace Settings > Workspace Quotas in the left navigation pane.
